about: Every bullet main enforced by a totality oracle alone on 2026-10-12, by shape. A door is a bullet whose truth rests on nobody reaching a thing except through one place; only a door is chokepoint material, and only where the thing is a project symbol a reference can name. Shapes other than door were assigned by reading the sentence; the why of a behaviour or text row is generic unless the row was read against the code.
